'''Far Pando''' was a peaceful [[Agriworld/Legends|agrarian]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Far Pando system/Legends|Far Pando system]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was situated along the [[Pando Spur/Legends|Pando Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], an offshoot of the larger [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]]. The planet was under the control of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Yahk-Tosh]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Far Pando was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-13.<ref name="TEA" />
